tasks.label: Build Tauri release binary
args: set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%&& cd /d src-tauri&& cargo build --release --bin reading-vocab-desktop

args: set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%&& cd /d src-tauri&& ..\frontend\node_modules\.bin\tauri.cmd build --bundles nsis
